blocks.text: Located in scenic White Rock, British Columbia, Inspire Change Wellness is a top-rated addiction treatment center for men. They specialize in drug and alcohol recovery, focusing on co-occurring mental health conditions. With a commitment to personalized treatment, Inspire Change develops tailored plans for every individual. They also offer on-site medical detox, complete with around-the-clock-care. Their treatment approach blends evidence-based therapies with holistic options, creating a comprehensive approach to sobriety.

sections.heading: Treatment Options at Inspire Change Wellness Center

blocks.text: Inspire Change Wellness provides a range of treatment options to help clients achieve lasting recovery. This includes individual and group therapy and family therapy with trained counselors. The team utilizes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), and motivational interviewing (MI) in their counseling services. They also offer a range of topic groups, including self-esteem, stress management, life transitions, relapse prevention, and goal-setting. Alongside traditional options, Inspire Change also offers holistic therapies such as physical fitness, yoga, breathing, mindfulness meditation, nutritional counseling, and self-affirmation.

sections.heading: Accommodations at Inspire Change Wellness Center

blocks.text: Inspire Change Wellness offers luxurious accommodations and well-rounded care in recovery. The multi-level home features modern architecture and can house up to 15 residents at a time in semi-private and private rooms. Each room comes equipped with a queen-sized bed, large en suite bathroom, plenty of closet space, and large windows with ocean views. The home also offers spacious common areas and outdoor balconies, allowing clients to relax and enjoy the stunning scenery. Meals are provided by a trained chef, and clients can take advantage of the large fitness center and spa.

centre.about_html:
Located in scenic White Rock, British Columbia, Inspire Change Wellness is a top-rated addiction treatment center for men. They specialize in drug and alcohol recovery, focusing on co-occurring mental health conditions. With a commitment to personalized treatment, Inspire Change develops tailored plans for every individual. They also offer on-site medical detox, complete with around-the-clock-care. Their treatment approach blends evidence-based therapies with holistic options, creating a comprehensive approach to sobriety. 

Treatment Options at Inspire Change Wellness Center

Inspire Change Wellness provides a range of treatment options to help clients achieve lasting recovery. This includes individual and group therapy and family therapy with trained counselors. The team utilizes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), and motivational interviewing (MI) in their counseling services. They also offer a range of topic groups, including self-esteem, stress management, life transitions, relapse prevention, and goal-setting. Alongside traditional options, Inspire Change also offers holistic therapies such as physical fitness, yoga, breathing, mindfulness meditation, nutritional counseling, and self-affirmation.

Accommodations at Inspire Change Wellness Center

Inspire Change Wellness offers luxurious accommodations and well-rounded care in recovery. The multi-level home features modern architecture and can house up to 15 residents at a time in semi-private and private rooms. Each room comes equipped with a queen-sized bed, large en suite bathroom, plenty of closet space, and large windows with ocean views. The home also offers spacious common areas and outdoor balconies, allowing clients to relax and enjoy the stunning scenery. Meals are provided by a trained chef, and clients can take advantage of the large fitness center and spa.

Aftercare and Support at Inspire Change Wellness Center

At Inspire Change Wellness Center, aftercare is key to lasting recovery. They provide free aftercare treatment in the event of a relapse, giving clients continued support throughout their journey. Additionally, they offer individualized discharge and aftercare plans, ensuring clients have continued access to support and resources long after leaving the program.



Inspire Change Wellness Center - Center Overview

Inspire Change Wellness Center is a top-notch rehabilitation center that focuses on addressing substance abuse, drug addiction, and other substance use disorders. The center offers personalized care to each patient, creating customized treatment plans tailored to their individual needs. The team at Inspire Change Wellness understands that addiction is a complex disease, and the treatment program is designed to help patients overcome their substance use disorder and live a healthy and productive life.

With a range of therapies and activities on offer, Inspire Change Wellness Center provides patients with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and exercise. The center offers medications-assisted therapy, peer support groups, family counseling sessions, art therapy, yoga classes, and more. With a focus on evidence-based and non-12 step treatment philosophies, patients can rest assured that they are receiving the highest quality care available in the industry. Aftercare services, such as group therapy and online aftercare, are also provided to ensure ongoing support for patients once they leave the center.

Program Length

30–90 days

Cost

12,000–30,000 CAD

Located in scenic White Rock, British Columbia, Inspire Change Wellness is a top-rated addiction treatment center for men. They specialize in drug and alcohol recovery, focusing on co-occurring mental health conditions. With a commitment to personalized treatment, Inspire Change develops tailored plans for every individual. They also offer on-site medical detox, complete with around-the-clock-care. Their treatment approach blends evidence-based therapies with holistic options, creating a comprehensive approach to sobriety. 

Treatment Options at Inspire Change Wellness Center

Inspire Change Wellness provides a range of treatment options to help clients achieve lasting recovery. This includes individual and group therapy and family therapy with trained counselors. The team utilizes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), and motivational interviewing (MI) in their counseling services. They also offer a range of topic groups, including self-esteem, stress management, life transitions, relapse prevention, and goal-setting. Alongside traditional options, Inspire Change also offers holistic therapies such as physical fitness, yoga, breathing, mindfulness meditation, nutritional counseling, and self-affirmation.

Accommodations at Inspire Change Wellness Center

Inspire Change Wellness offers luxurious accommodations and well-rounded care in recovery. The multi-level home features modern architecture and can house up to 15 residents at a time in semi-private and private rooms. Each room comes equipped with a queen-sized bed, large en suite bathroom, plenty of closet space, and large windows with ocean views. The home also offers spacious common areas and outdoor balconies, allowing clients to relax and enjoy the stunning scenery. Meals are provided by a trained chef, and clients can take advantage of the large fitness center and spa.

Aftercare and Support at Inspire Change Wellness Center

At Inspire Change Wellness Center, aftercare is key to lasting recovery. They provide free aftercare treatment in the event of a relapse, giving clients continued support throughout their journey. Additionally, they offer individualized discharge and aftercare plans, ensuring clients have continued access to support and resources long after leaving the program.

The center offers personalized care to each patient, creating customized treatment plans tailored to their individual needs. With a range of therapies and activities on offer, Inspire Change Wellness Center provides patients with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and exercise. The center offers medications-assisted therapy, peer support groups, family counseling sessions, art therapy, yoga classes, and more. With a focus on evidence-based and non-12 step treatment philosophies, patients can rest assured that they are receiving the highest quality care available in the industry. Aftercare services, such as group therapy and online aftercare, are also provided to ensure ongoing support for patients once they leave the center.
